text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Welcome~!

It happened during the middle of the day, with the sun hanging high in the sky.
I found myself surrounded by a large crowd of young Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for inviting me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone!
Let's show the Tracen Academy Trainer
just how hard we've been working!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Yeees!

This is the 'Victory Club,'
a renowned club for training young Umamusume.

With an abundant track record as a development club,
this high-caliber team has produced
many prominent athletes who later made a name for themselves.

Today, to study up as a trainer,
I was paying a visit to observe the "Victory Club."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
We're practicing outside today,
so let's make sure not to get injured!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text: Got it~!
choice_data_list: You two are alumnae of this club, right?
You two are alumnae of this club, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If you have any questions,
please ask anything of this Class Rep... no, today,
this graduate!
choice_data_list: I heard there are a lot of "Sakura" girls, though?

text_block_list.text:
I hear there are many girls in this club with 'Sakura' in their names.
Like Sakura Bakushin O and Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: About that, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The name "Sakura" is naturally
drawn to the Victory Club!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Truly, this is destiny!
The fate tied to the name 'Sakura'
and the 'Victory Club' are drawn to one another!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, well...
My mother was part of this club, so that's how the connection was made.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: She seems to cherish connections like that, which I think is one reason why there are so many "Sakura" girls.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, my mother was also
an alumna of this 'Victory Club'!
Ha-ha-ha-ha!

We observe the little kids during their practice.
As expected of a famous club, their training regimen is extremely well-structured.
choice_data_list: The level of competition really is high.
The level of competition really is high.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Also, since this is a club for little kids,
training is strictly kept to levels that won't strain their bodies.

To keep training from getting boring, I also mix in ball games like dodgeball.
For the kids, it must be pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Ouch...!

It was right then.
One of the kids from the club took a hard fall!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
You mustn't help them right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "And the motto of Victory Club is...!?"

text_block_list.name: Fallen Girl
text_block_list.text:
S-Strong feelings!
Positive and brimming with energy...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
You're a member of this club too! You're a strong kid who can get back up on your own!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you hurt? Try rotating your leg a bit, okay?
...Yeah, looks like you're fine.
Then let's give it a little effort, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Fallen Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! 
I can do this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do our best!
Here we go together!
Victory!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Victory!

And so, the still-so-young girl
stood up firmly on her own two feet,
and ran off toward everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer!
How do you like this "Victory Club"!?
choice_data_list: This is a really great club!
This is a really great club!
I've figured out the secret to both of your strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer!
How do you like this "Victory Club"!?
choice_data_list: This is a really great club!
This is a really great club!
I've figured out the secret to both of your strength.

text_block_list.text:
Everyone on this team believes in their comrades.
Together, we can overcome any hardship.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Isn't it?!
This club is my absolute pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Even two different carrots grow in the same soil," right!
Victory Club. It was a strong, spirited club where members supported each other through deep bonds.

Right here and now, I learned that
extending a helping hand isn't the only form of kindness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the 'Sakura' girls
are all formidable opponents, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Please look forward to what the kids from Victory Club can do!"

I can't afford to slack off either!
It turned out to be a truly fulfilling day that renewed my motivation.
